title: Silver Royalty Company Dividend Yields (Oct 26, 2023)
takeaway: Silver royalty companies offer varying dividend yields.

data.label: Wheaton Precious Metals
data.evidence: As of Q2 2024, WPM’s dividend yield was approximately 7.2%.

narration: Several silver royalty companies offer attractive dividend yields. As of October 26, 2023, Wheaton Precious Metals had a dividend yield of 7.8%, Franco-Nevada Mining had an 8.0% yield, and Pan Resources offered 7.5%.
